Hand the image half to any OpenAI-shaped API instead and its "},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 场记 / Continuity"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives an
agent local image / speech / music / SFX generation, the tra"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"nscription to hear its own output
back, **and a memory of what it made** — the same character stays "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"the same character across
every call, and a failed generation is never allowed to pass as a success."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Runs locally. Models are lazy-loaded per request and released when idle, so **when you are
not using"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" it the GPU is untouched** — 0.21 GiB resident, measured. You can play a game on
the same card."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Or keep only the half you want local: image generation speaks any OpenAI-shaped `/v1/images/*`
API a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd transcription any OpenAI-shaped `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, and telling `continuity-setup`
so mea"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ns that half's engine and weights are never downloaded — the 8 GiB VRAM gate leaves with the
image h"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"alf. See Bring your own backend."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> 场记 is the continuity supervisor on a film set. Their entire job is two things: make sure
> the cos"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"tume, hair and props match between takes, and catch the mistake on set before it is
> cut into the f"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ilm. That is exactly this plugin's job."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What it looks like"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"One `create_character` call fixed this face. Everything after it is a single `subject_image`
call ca"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"rrying nothing but a scene — no reference image passed by hand, no re-describing the
character, no r"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"etouching. These are the files the tools returned."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"create_character — the reference every later call is held against"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"“close-up portrait, lit from below by a lantern”"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"“strict side profile, on a cliff edge at dusk”"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"“from behind, looking back over her shoulder, snow”"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"“sitting by a campfire, cleaning her gauntlet, low angle”"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"“wearing heavy red lacquered plate armour”"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"“as a stark black and white woodcut print”"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The blind right eye, the scar through the brow, the bone pendant and the brass gauntlet come
through"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" all seven. That is the entire point: the same description through `generate_image`
gives you a diff"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"erent woman every time, which is how a game ends up with three protagonists."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Two things it did **not** do, kept here because a demo that only shows the wins teaches you
nothing "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"id **not** do, kept here because a demo that only shows the wins teaches you
nothing about the tool:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Style requests only partly take.** The woodcut landed. "Pixel-art sprite" was asked for
twice an"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"d ignored both times — the reference image dominates the style of the output, which
is exactly the m"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"echanism that makes the face hold.
- **The armour is layered, not swapped.** The face and the gauntl"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"et held, but the red plate
went on *over* the grey coat instead of replacing it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## What it can do"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| | tools | |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| **Look** | `create_character` `create_animal` `create_object` `import_subject` `subject_image` | p"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"in a character, animal or prop once; every later image is that one |
| **Voice** | `create_actor` `i"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"mport_actor` `actor_tts` | cast a voice once; every later line is that voice |
| **Hearing** | `tran"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"scribe` | read a WAV back as text — including one this plugin just made |
| **Music** | `generate_mu"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"sic` | Stable Audio, up to 120 s, no loop points — score a scene, not a BGM loop |
| **SFX** | `gen_"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"sfx` `sfx_presets` | procedural sfxr: milliseconds, byte-identical for a given seed, no model and no"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" VRAM at all |
| **One-offs** | `generate_image` `generate_speech` | for things that never recur; th"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"eir own descriptions say so and point back at the pinning tools |
| **Post** | `remove_bg` `slice_sh"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"eet` | real RGBA cutout (CPU), and a grid sheet cut into single frames |
| **State** | `continuity_s"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"tatus` | which engines are up, which capabilities are on, where the assets live |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Two of these read *in* rather than write out, and they are the ones people miss:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **`import_actor` / `import_subject`** pin something you already have — a real actor's
recording, a"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" character sheet drawn elsewhere — and everything downstream is identical to a
natively cast one (me"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"asured: an imported actor tracks a native one to 11 Hz).
- **`transcribe`** closes the loop. A clone"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"d line that swallowed its last two words sounds
completely normal; it is only visible once you read "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"it back and compare it to the script.
That is also what fills in an imported recording's transcript "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"when you don't have one (the
ASR model loads on demand and unloads with the rest — 3.05 GB while res"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"ident, 0.4 s for
9.5 s of audio)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The table above is the short version — all 21 tools, grouped, are in Tools."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Minimum requirements"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| | Minimum | Notes |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| **GPU** | **8 GiB VRAM** | Peak is 6.80 GiB (measured). Requests are serialized, so peak is one mo"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"del, not the sum. |
| **GPU API** | **Vulkan 1.2+** | **No CUDA, no ROCm.** Kernels are SPIR-V compi"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"led at runtime. |
| **Disk** | **34 GiB during install**, 21.8 GiB after | 19.7 weights + 2.1 runtim"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"e image + 8.5 build layers (reclaimable) + 4 headroom. |
| **Host RAM** | **16 GiB** (8 GiB workable"},{"id":"p27s5","text":" — see below) | Driven by transient peaks, not idle. |
| **CPU** | any x86-64 | Background removal r"},{"id":"p27s6","text":" | Driven by transient peaks, not idle. |
| **CPU** | any x86-64 | Background removal runs on CPU. |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Audio-only installs (see below) need **20 GiB during install, 9.5 GiB after**."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Every row above is about the halves you run **locally**. `--image-api-server` (or `--sd-server`)
dro"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ps the GPU row to the 4 GiB the audio half needs and leaves 10.1 GiB of weights undownloaded,
`--asr"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"-server` another 2.3 GiB, and `--audio-server` the rest — see
Bring your own backend."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"All VRAM/RAM figures on this page are **GiB** (2³⁰ bytes), which is what `rocm-smi` and
`vulkaninfo`"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" report. An earlier version of this README labelled them GB; that was wrong and
made the headroom lo"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ok tighter than it is."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Vulkan instead of CUDA is not a preference — it is why this runs at all. ROCm miscomputes
VAE decode"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" on this GPU class (ROCm#6633):
five decodes of identical input returned five mutually uncorrelated "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"results. Vulkan/RADV
compiles SPIR-V at runtime instead of looking up a per-arch kernel table, and i"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"s correct
and faster here. The side effect is portability across all three vendors."}],"truncated":true}
